stops.name: Seebuck

stops.name: Bismarckdenkmal
stops.detail: The Feldberg is recognizable today by the old and new television towers as well as the Bismarck monument on the Seebuck.

stops.name: Friedrich-Luise-Turm
stops.detail: The highest point of the terrain lies on a flat hill about 20 m west of the Friedrich-Luise Tower.
